outcome.verified_contract: An exact session selector narrows continuation only after Control verifies the authenticated principal, campaign identity, project link, checkout, lifecycle, and overlapping claims. Foreign sessions and campaign/session mismatches remain denied.
outcome.analysis_limit: Repository tests establish the Control implementation contract; they do not establish that every already-running client has refreshed its captured MCP tool surface.

related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign
related_work.work_intent_goal: exercise canonical Environment persistence through the Control socket

pressure_hypothesis.title: A caller cannot reliably reselect an authenticated session after losing local context
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: Control LocalEnvironmentMCP continuation and project-session selection
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The live Environment client reported an ambiguous campaign inventory when asked to use an exact session identity. Control now carries that selector through its continuation route and applies the existing principal, campaign, project-link, checkout, and claim checks.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Carry an exact session selector through the client continuation adapter and Control's authenticated project-link validation; inspect the active client surface after integration before assessing effectiveness.
not_measured: recurrence across independent clients, sessions, or campaigns
whether the selector mismatch caused lost or duplicated development work
client registration refresh behavior after the Control source update
effectiveness on the active client MCP registration
whether the session-selection pressure recurs in other campaigns
token use, cache accounting, execution duration, and resource consumption
